elements.description: Phone AIZZAK bar at the top of the content with the original, unretinted 36dp logo; no wide navigation rail is present.
AIZZAK brand name and localized AI Assistant descriptor are stacked beside the logo, start-aligned, with the descriptor using the muted text role.
Localized eyebrow text appears above the title, start-aligned, primary colored, semibold and visually smaller than the supporting copy.
Localized Your assistants screen title is start-aligned, semibold, approximately 28sp at font scale 1.0, and exposed as a heading.
Localized supporting introduction appears directly below the title in the muted role, before the agent-card column.

First single-column surface card is Smart Assistant: 20dp content padding, approximately 20dp corner radius, violet start accent, violet icon container and decorative sparkle icon; the whole card is non-interactive.
Smart Assistant name remains LTR in both locales, is start-aligned beside the icon, and wraps without ellipsis or truncation.
Localized Smart Assistant description is directly below its name, uses the muted role and wraps without clipping.
Localized Coming later status chip follows the Smart Assistant description with soft-container fill, outline, pill shape and a visible status dot.

Second single-column surface card is Data Search: same structure and spacing as the first card, with cyan start accent, cyan icon container and decorative search icon; the whole card is non-interactive.
Data Search name remains LTR in both locales, is start-aligned beside the icon, and wraps without ellipsis or truncation.
Localized Data Search description is directly below its name, uses the muted role and wraps without clipping.
Localized Coming later status chip follows the Data Search description with soft-container fill, outline, pill shape and a visible status dot.

Third single-column surface card is Wire Twin: same structure and spacing as the preceding cards, with amber start accent, amber icon container and decorative wiring icon; the whole card is non-interactive.
Wire Twin name remains LTR in both locales, is start-aligned beside the icon, and wraps without ellipsis or truncation.
Localized Wire Twin description is directly below its name, uses the muted role and wraps without clipping.
Localized Coming later status chip follows the Wire Twin description with soft-container fill, outline, pill shape and a visible status dot.
Primary-container information callout follows the third card, with a decorative info icon and localized assistants-being-prepared text; it wraps and remains reachable by vertical scrolling.
Home item is the selected destination in the phone bottom navigation, with icon, localized label and a non-color-only selected treatment using the filled icon pill.
Account item appears in the phone bottom navigation with user icon and localized label, unselected, with at least a 48dp touch target.
Settings item appears in the phone bottom navigation with settings icon and localized label, unselected, with at least a 48dp touch target; no side rail is rendered in this scope.
